assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: transparent sprite atlas for an original medieval mercenary hex tactics game. Create exactly EIGHT separate full-color hand-painted half-body tabletop character tokens, arranged precisely in FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows on a square transparent canvas. Each cell contains ONE isolated complete bust including head, shoulders, arms, visible weapon and waist, no legs. Tokens all same scale, from a consistent slightly elevated 3/4 orthographic camera (similar to painted historical board game miniatures), facing slightly to viewer's RIGHT. Row 1 left-to-right: (1) grizzled male captain in chainmail coif, scarred face, iron sword and battered blue heater shield; (2) young male spearman with nasal helmet, leather padded coat, long ash spear and round wood shield; (3) brown-haired female hunter in moss hood, leather vest, holding yew longbow; (4) bearded heavy mercenary with kettle helmet, dark brigandine, broad battle axe in both hands. Row 2 left-to-right: (5) lean bandit in rough brown tunic carrying a wooden cudgel and buckler; (6) bald bandit axeman in cracked leather, red neck cloth, round shield; (7) grey-hooded bandit crossbowman aiming a medieval crossbow; (8) bandit leader in rusted iron helmet, patched mail, red sash, holding falchion and steel shield. Cohesive restrained olive, umber, aged blue and rust palette. Beautiful detailed faces and cloth, strong ink outlines, brush textures, tangible metal and wood, serious medieval low fantasy. Dark outlines and bright upper-left highlights readable at small game size. Each figure stays fully within its own cell with 12% clear margins, hands/weapons cannot cross cell boundaries, no labels, no numbers, no borders, no ground, no pedestal, no shadows outside busts. NOT chibi, NOT cartoon icons, NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D render. True transparent alpha background throughout.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: hand-painted terrain texture atlas for an original medieval hex tactics game. A wide rectangular canvas of aspect ratio 3:2 split invisibly into exactly THREE equal columns and TWO equal rows, SIX square texture swatches completely filling their cells. No borders or gaps or labels. Top-down orthographic hand-painted earth, realistic game environment detail, subdued sage-olive-ochre low fantasy palette, no perspective. Row1 left to right: 1 dense dry meadow grass with fine blades, tiny white flowers and mossy ochre dirt, seamless feel; 2 worn medieval dirt road with subtle wheel tracks and small pebbles, no large props; 3 exposed rocky hilltop, desaturated warm grey stone slabs, sparse dry grass and lichen. Row2 left to right: 4 thick low scrub grass, fern leaves, brambles and tiny dark bushes viewed vertically, uniform without a central object; 5 shallow dark green stream water with visible smooth riverbed stones and delicate silver ripples, no bank; 6 wet dark brown muddy bank with hoof marks, scattered reeds and wet gravel. Soft ambient daylight from upper left. Texture variation continuous over each entire cell, detailed at 512 pixels. Painterly brush marks and delicate ink accents, serious tactical RPG quality, no UI, no characters, no grid, no hexagon edges, no text. Use opaque background.

High-quality consistent assets for a serious strategy game.
